capital.evidence_quote: Dhaka is the capital and historic mega-city of the People's Republic of Bangladesh

currency.evidence_quote: The Bangladeshi Taka (BDT, ৳) is the official currency; trades around 118 BDT to 1 USD

timezone.evidence_quote: Bangladesh Standard Time is 6 hours ahead of UTC year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard single-phase domestic electrical supply across Bangladesh is 220V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: National alternating current grid operating frequency is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Multi-standard sockets accept European Type C, British Type D, Type G, and Type K plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 for national emergency police services across Bangladesh

sources.title: Directorate General of Health Services Bangladesh

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 999 for national emergency ambulance and medical dispatch

sources.title: Bangladesh Fire Service and Civil Defence

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 999 or 102 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 999 is the central unified national emergency dispatch center

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Police Bangladesh 24-hour command center operates at +880 1320-001299 and via 999

advisory_headline.tr: Bangladeş'te siyasi gösteriler ve yoğun trafik nedeniyle dikkatli olunmalıdır; Sundarbans ve Cox's Bazar turistik bölgeleri rehber eşliğinde güvenlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise increased caution due to political rallies and traffic congestion; the Sundarbans and Cox's Bazar are safe with registered guides.
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht wegen politischer Demonstrationen und dichter Verkehrslage in Großstädten.
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте повышенную осторожность в связи с политическими митингами; курорт Кокс-Базар и Сундарбан безопасны с гидами.
advisory_headline.es: Actúe con mayor cautela debido a manifestaciones políticas; Sundarbans y Cox's Bazar son seguros con guías autorizados.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Bangladesh reach approximately 24.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Dhaka measure 44.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Grameenphone, Banglalink, and Robi provide prepaid 4G SIMs at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport (DAC) in Dhaka. Biometric fingerprint registration and passport copy are mandatory for all SIM activations.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: SIM card registration requires biometric verification and passport copy under BTRC directives

religion.evidence_quote: Islam is the state religion while constitutionally guaranteeing religious harmony and freedom for minority faiths

festivals.value: Pohela Boishakh (Bengali New Year on April 14 celebrated with Mangal Shobhajatra - UNESCO), Eid-ul-Fitr, Durga Puja, Language Martyrs' Day (Feb 21)
festivals.evidence_quote: Mangal Shobhajatra on Bengali New Year is inscribed by UNESCO for its message of unity and secular celebration

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Dress conservatively: shoulders and legs should be covered in public; women should carry a scarf when visiting mosques. Avoid unbottled tap water and raw street salads. Friday is the religious holy day with many government offices and shops closed.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Conservative attire respecting Islamic and Bengali cultural norms is expected in public spaces

tipping.value: Tipping 5-10% is customary in upscale Dhaka restaurants. Tipping hotel luggage staff (50-100 BDT) and tour guides is standard practice.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 5-10% tip is standard in hospitality and full-service dining
